recommendation.reason: With the best comparable score now 47.7% (own leaderboard, 2026-11-11), recommend needs both Real and Solid to be strong.
risks: Only Lite task inputs are public; complete packages and rubrics require approval.
Judge agreement is measured on rubric items, not whole-level pass decisions.
Repeated-run evidence concerns fixed-submission grading rather than full agent evaluations.

release.quote: | [Full Packages](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Continual-Learning-Exam/CLE-Lite-Full) | Complete task packages, container environments, runtime, and evaluation material | Approval required |

redistribution_questions: What do the dataset usage terms require for evaluation and redistribution?

rights.quote: Third-party materials retain their original terms; each package's `NOTICE.md` and `PROVENANCE.md` record sources, permissions, and retrieval details. See the [dataset's usage terms](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Continual-Learning-Exam/CLE-Lite#data-sources-and-terms) for evaluation and redistribution requirements.

tasks.quote: For downloadable packages, **CLE Lite** provides **20 tasks and 100 levels**. The main evaluation covers the full 120-task benchmark.

verifier.full_credit: A level passes only when every criterion is satisfied.
verifier.quote: Choose either DeepSeek V4 Flash through OpenRouter or GPT-6.1-Sol through Codex as the judge; the OpenRouter option also needs an API key.

oracle.quote: | [Rubrics](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Continual-Learning-Exam/CLE-Lite-Rubrics) | Evaluation rubrics and reference answers | Approval required |

exceptions: CLE Lite Full and Rubrics require approval

runtime.quote: You will need Linux x86-64, Bash, Docker with Compose, `curl`, Python 3.10+, `uv`, Node.js 22+, approved access to [CLE Lite Full](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Continual-Learning-Exam/CLE-Lite-Full), and a Codex login for the solver. Reserve at least **30 GB for a single example task**. Choose either DeepSeek V4 Flash through OpenRouter or GPT-6.1-Sol through Codex as the judge; the OpenRouter option also needs an API key.
